title: High-Mileage Care (100k+ Miles)
subtitle: Celebrate the miles — then protect them with fluids, leaks, belts/hoses, and honest shop calls.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel. Phase 2 high-mileage: encourage longevity; timing belts are shop-critical.

parts_checklist: Quality oil + filter on shorter intervals if severe use
Coolant / brake fluid only to spec via proper service

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Past 100k: shorten oil intervals if trips are short/dusty, and inspect for leaks every service.
Past 150k: budget for mounts, suspension bushings, and cooling-system age. Listen for new noises early.
Many engines use timing belts with hard mileage/time limits — verify your engine. Belt jobs are shop work.
High-mile EV: 12V, brakes (low regeneration wear patterns), coolant loops, and suspension still matter — HV pack diagnostics are shop-only.
